name: Spirula Studio
description: Official Spirula Studio 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer, integrated at the process boundary as a standalone GPLv3 executable. Launch the full upstream GUI (training, editing, rendering, meshing), then import the trained splat.ply or mesh.ply into the ACloudViewer DB tree. The executable is built by BUILD_SPIRULA (ExternalProject, SPIRULA_TAG) and carries no source patches, so upstream sync is a tag bump plus smoke tests.
